BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify that the acceptance criteria have been met. While the agent claims all 31 tests pass and describes the root cause and fix, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or other artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires that "all 31 tests pass," which demands verifiable proof, not self-attestation.
